items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes. I remember him working with me at Lake Tahoe. We had a nice rhythm section.

ctx.x: In the midst of – really, everything’s building up, and you get married to a drummer. Did he work with you?
Yes. I remember him working with me at Lake Tahoe. We had a nice rhythm section. I don’t remember who else was in it, but I do know that – basically, I was working in rooms that had big bands.
How soon did you start a family?
